title: Measurement of mitochondrial respiration in adherent cells by Seahorse XF96 Cell Mito Stress Test
protocol: Seed 5 × 10^4 HK-2 cells in a sterile 6-well plate with 2 mL of growth medium (DMEM supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum) without antibiotics.
Incubate the cells overnight to achieve approximately 60%-80% confluency by Day 2.
Dilute 3.75 μL Lipofectamine 3000 in 125 μL Opti-MEM and mix gently.
Dilute 2500 ng DNA in 125 μL of serum-free Opti-MEM, then add 5 μL p3000 to it and mix gently.
Combine the diluted Lipofectamine 3000 with the diluted DNA mixture and mix gently.
Incubate the combined solution for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
Add the transfection complexes to each well containing cells and medium.
Incubate the transfected cells in a cell culture incubator with a humidified atmosphere of 5% CO2 at 37°C for 24 h.
Harvest and plate 6 x 10^3 HK-2 cells in 100 μL growth medium per well, excluding four background temperature correction wells which should be blanked with 100 μL of growth medium.
Place the Seahorse XF96 cell culture microplate in the tissue culture hood for 1 hour at 20°C–25°C.
Incubate cells for 12-18 hours in a cell culture incubator after seeding.
Seed cells uniformly without resuspending them once placed in the XF96 Cell Culture Microplate.
Ensure background correction wells contain medium only, free of cells.
Place sensory cartridge upside down on the bench and avoid contact with the sensors.
Fill each well of the utility plate with 200 μL Seahorse XF Calibrant.
Lower the sensory cartridge back onto the utility plate gently and avoid creating air bubbles.
Incubate the sensory cartridge in a non-CO2, 37°C incubator for 12–18 h.
Make sure the environment of the incubator is humidified.
Power on the Seahorse XFe96 Analyzer.
Turn on the non-CO2, 37°C incubator and computer.
Open the “Wave” software.
Click the “Heater on.”
Observe whether the temperature in the software is rising to 37°C.
Ensure that the instrument connection status turns green indicating normal connection (lower-left corner of the screen).
Turn on the Seahorse instruments at least 5 h prior to running the assay.
Prepare the Seahorse assay medium, cells, and XF Cell Stress Test Compounds for running the assay.
Warm the water bath to 37°C.
Add 1 mL of 100 mM pyruvate solution.
Add 1 mL of 200 mM glutamine solution.
Add 0.1 g of D-glucose.
Filtrate the assay medium with a 0.22 μm filter.
Warm the assay medium to 37°C.
Adjust pH to 7.4 with 1 M NaOH.
Retrieve the XF96 Cell Culture Microplate from the cell incubator.
Remove cell growth medium, leaving 20 μL remaining.
Replace removed medium with 180 μL of assay medium.
Repeat the removal and replacement steps two more times.
Aspirate 180 μL of assay medium and replace with 160 μL of assay medium.
Incubate the XF96 Cell Culture Microplate in a 37°C incubator without CO2 for 1 hour.
Suspend compounds with assay medium according to Table 1.
Dilute stock solutions of Oligomycin, FCCP, and Rotenone/Antimycin A according to Table 2.
Load 20 μL of 2 μM oligomycin in port A.
Load 22 μL of 1 μM FCCP in port B.
Load 25 μL of 0.5 μM Rotenone/Antimycin A in port C of the hydrated sensory cartridge.
Prepare and load compounds 20 minutes prior to the assay.
Set up the XF Cell Mito Stress Test protocol in the Templates window.
At the Plate map page, add a group and select corresponding wells to edit information for your group.
At the Protocol page, set baseline parameters to include 3 cycles.
For Port A (oligomycin), inject and run 3 cycles.
For Port B (FCCP), inject and run 3 cycles.
For Port C (Rotenone/antimycin A), inject and run 3 cycles.
Each cycle involves mixing for 3 minutes, waiting for 0 minutes, and measuring for 3 minutes.
Select “Start Run” at the Run Assay page and choose a location to save your assay result file.
The instrument will initiate calibration of the sensory cartridge after selection.
Wait approximately 20 minutes for the calibration process to complete.
Open the tray after calibration is complete.
Remove the utility plate from the tray.
Replace the XF96 Cell Culture Microplate on the tray with the correct orientation, located at the lower-left corner of the tray.
Load the tray onto the device.
Ensure that compounds are injected in the port before starting the assay.
View cells under a microscope to check cell health and seeding confluence.
Remove background wells without cells.
Complete the run according to the default XF Cell Mito Stress Test protocol, which takes 1 hour 24 minutes.
Remove the cell plate and sensory cartridges after the run is completed.
Insert a USB drive to export results from the Wave software.
Export data as an Excel or Prism file using the Wave software.
